    The independent mesh category and the scalar mesh categories of Γ_A #

    The path category of the independent quiver Γ_A is definitionally the linear path category of the proof library. Granted that the independent translate, defined by almost split sequences, is the translation of Γ_A in the proof library (TranslateCompatible), the independent mesh relations are the all-one mesh relations, so the independent k(Γ_A) is the scalar mesh category with all coefficients one. A gauge transformation (Lemma 4.4) then identifies it with the scalar mesh category whose coefficients come from the almost split sequences.
